title: POIROT: Agents as their own auditors for failure attribution in large language model multi-agent systems
abstract: arXiv:2606.02282v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Large language model (LLM)-based multi-agent systems (LLM-MAS) are kept out of safety-critical domains by emergent failures that are hard to detect and to attribute. Current evaluation relies on a centralised evaluator, human or LLM judge, that must master the domain and hold the whole interaction history in one context. We propose that the agents executing a task can themselves attribute its failures. We introduce POIROT (Phased Oversight via Introspection, Review and Opinion Tallying), a modular protocol in which each agent casts a private vote within a hazard space derived from the system architecture, and the votes are aggregated into a single attribution. translated_title: POIROT：让智能体成为自己的审计员，用于大语言模型多智能体系统中的故障归因
translated_abstract: 基于大语言模型的多智能体系统（LLM-MAS）因存在难以检测和难以归因的涌现性故障，一直被排除在安全关键领域之外。当前的评估依赖于一个集中式评估器——无论是人类还是大语言模型裁判——该评估器必须精通相关领域，并将完整的交互历史保存在同一个上下文中。我们提出，执行任务的智能体自身就能对这些故障进行归因。我们引入了POIROT（Phased Oversight via Introspection, Review and Opinion Tallying，即通过内省、审查与意见汇总实现分阶段监督），这是一个模块化协议：每个智能体在从系统架构导出的风险空间中进行秘密投票，各票随后被汇总为单一的归因结果。在投票之前，协议加入了逐步增加智能体间交互的阶段，从独立的自我评估，到共享各自的自我评估结果，再到同伴质询。我们逐阶段构建该协议，并通过消融实验衡量每个阶段的贡献。
tldr: 该论文提出POIROT模块化协议，让执行任务的多智能体通过分阶段递进的内省、共享自我评估与同伴质询，以秘密投票方式自行完成故障归因，从而摆脱对集中式评估器的依赖。
en_tdlr: POIROT is a modular protocol enabling agents in LLM-based multi-agent systems to attribute failures themselves through phased introspection, shared self-assessments, peer interrogation, and private voting aggregated into a single attribution, removing reliance on centralized evaluators.
